name: Ho'olei at Grand Wailea
positioning: Private, gated villa community in Wailea, across from Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort, blending residential living with resort amenities
best_for: Families and groups who want a multi-bedroom villa with its own kitchen
Travelers who want home-style space plus access to Grand Wailea's amenities

facts.text: Ho'olei is a private, gated community across from Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort.
The property offers spacious villas and blends residential living with resort amenities.
Villa types include Garden View, Ocean View and Deluxe Ocean View three-bedroom villas.
The Ocean View 3 Bedroom Villa sleeps 8 and has a balcony.
Each two-story villa has a full kitchen, an elevator, a washer and dryer, a garage and an outdoor grill.
Ho'olei has its own pool and fitness center, in addition to access to Grand Wailea's amenities, restaurants and spa.
The daily resort charge includes morning beach yoga and afternoon garden yoga.
The daily resort charge includes beach cruiser bikes and twice daily scuba clinics.
The property is in Wailea, 17 miles from Kahului Airport.

highlights.text: The pool has a sandy beach entry and waterfalls, and there is a children's pool.
Guests also have access to the amenities at Grand Wailea, A Waldorf Astoria Resort.
The O'hana Grilling service carts guests' chosen menu items to their villa for them to grill.
The daily resort charge includes hula and ukulele lessons.
Each home has one attached garage and one covered carport.

considerations.text: Each villa is individually owned, so the decor varies.
Villas toward the bottom of the property are a five-minute walk from Grand Wailea, and the walk back is up a hill.
An airport shuttle from Kahului Airport is not available.
